<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?> <LinearLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" android:id="@+id/relativeLayout_recent" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginHorizontal="4dp" android:layout_marginVertical="8dp" android:background="@drawable/rounded_white_background" android:elevation="2dp" android:orientation="vertical">
<!-- Expandable section --> <FrameLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content">
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="vertical" android:paddingTop="8dp">
<!-- Main row (always visible) --> <LinearLayout android:id="@+id/main_content" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginBottom="8dp" android:orientation="horizontal">
<ImageView android:id="@+id/iconImageView" android:layout_width="40dp" android:layout_height="40dp" android:layout_marginHorizontal="12dp" android:background="@drawable/rounded_background9" android:padding="6dp" android:src="@drawable/lightning_bolt" />
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="vertical">
<TextView android:id="@+id/transactionTypeTextView" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:fontFamily="@font/montserratalternatess_bold" android:text="Transaction" android:textColor="@color/black" android:textSize="15sp" />
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="horizontal">
<TextView android:id="@+id/dateTextView" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:fontFamily="@font/montserratalternatess_regular" android:text="Jun 27" android:textAlignment="center" android:textColor="@color/grey" android:textSize="11sp" />
<!-- Status replaces "See Details >" --> <TextView android:id="@+id/detailsTextView" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginStart="12dp" android:fontFamily="@font/montserratalternatess_bold" android:text="Unpaid" android:textSize="12sp" /> </LinearLayout>
</LinearLayout>
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:gravity="end" android:orientation="vertical">
<TextView android:id="@+id/paymentAmountTextView" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginEnd="12dp" android:fontFamily="@font/montserratalternatess_bold" android:text="₱1,000" android:textColor="@color/darkBlue" android:textSize="16sp" />
</LinearLayout> </LinearLayout>
<LinearLayout android:id="@+id/expandable_layout" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="vertical" android:visibility="visible">
<View android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="1dp" android:layout_marginHorizontal="12dp" android:layout_marginBottom="8dp" android:background="#DDDDDD" />
<!-- Items table header --> <LinearLayout android:id="@+id/itemsTableHeader" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="horizontal" android:paddingHorizontal="4dp" android:paddingBottom="4dp">
<View android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="1dp" android:layout_weight="1"/>
<TextView android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginStart="5dp" android:layout_weight="2" android:fontFamily="@font/montserratalternatess_bold" android:text="Amount" android:textColor="@color/grey" android:textSize="10sp" />
<TextView android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_weight="2" android:fontFamily="@font/montserratalternatess_bold" android:text="Paid by" android:textColor="@color/grey" android:textSize="10sp" />
<TextView android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_weight="3" android:fontFamily="@font/montserratalternatess_bold" android:text="Description" android:textColor="@color/grey" android:textSize="10sp" />
</LinearLayout>
<!-- Items table rows container --> <LinearLayout android:id="@+id/itemsTableContainer" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginHorizontal="12dp" android:orientation="vertical" />
<View android:id="@+id/dividerBelowItems" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="1dp" android:layout_marginHorizontal="12dp" android:layout_marginVertical="8dp" android:background="#DDDDDD" />
<!-- Single item description (shown only for single-item transactions) --> <TextView android:id="@+id/tvSingleDescription" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginBottom="8dp" android:fontFamily="@font/montserratalternatess_regular" android:textColor="@color/grey" android:textSize="12sp" android:visibility="gone" />
<!-- Payors header + edit buttons --> <LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginBottom="6dp" android:gravity="center_vertical" android:orientation="horizontal" android:paddingHorizontal="12dp">
<TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:fontFamily="@font/montserratalternatess_bold" android:text="Payors" android:textSize="12sp" />
</LinearLayout>
<!-- Payors horizontal list --> <androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView android:id="@+id/payorsRecyclerView" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="horizontal" android:paddingHorizontal="12dp" />
<View android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="1dp" android:layout_marginHorizontal="12dp" android:layout_marginVertical="8dp" android:background="#DDDDDD" />
<!-- Created By --> <LinearLayout android:id="@+id/createdBy_LL" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="horizontal" android:paddingHorizontal="12dp">
<TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:fontFamily="@font/montserratalternatess_bold" android:text="Created by: " android:textSize="12sp" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/createdByTextView" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:fontFamily="@font/montserratalternatess_regular" android:textSize="12sp" />
</LinearLayout>
<!-- Settlement section --> <LinearLayout android:id="@+id/settlement_LL" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="12dp" android:orientation="vertical" android:visibility="visible">
<TextView android:id="@+id/editTransaction_btn" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:background="@drawable/bottom_round_border" android:fontFamily="@font/montserratalternatess_bold" android:paddingVertical="12dp" android:text="Settle" android:textAlignment="center" android:textColor="@color/whitest" android:textSize="14sp" />
</LinearLayout>
</LinearLayout>
</LinearLayout>
<!-- Loading overlay --> <LinearLayout android:id="@+id/loadingOverlay_transaction" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:background="@color/glassy_background" android:clickable="true" android:focusable="true" android:gravity="center" android:orientation="vertical" android:visibility="gone">
<ProgressBar style="@style/CustomProgressBarStyle" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" />
<TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="4dp" android:fontFamily="@font/montserratalternatess_regular" android:text="Loading details..." android:textSize="10sp" />
</LinearLayout>
</FrameLayout>
</LinearLayout>
